subject: Request: short-term token buffer for POC warm-up
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha@heliopay.com>
To: ben_carter
Date: 2026-06-10T09:15:00Z
Subject: Short-term token bump for POC warm-up

Hi Ben,

Quick note from HelioPay — we agreed to run a two-day soak starting next Friday (2026-06-12) to validate our transaction parser and end-to-end latency with a seeded dataset. The POC stage is the last gate before our internal security sign-off.

We expect bursty traffic during the warm-up window: roughly 25–35 qps sustained for 90 minutes each day and occasional spikes to ~80 qps for short sweeps. The model we'll run is the rdx-large-0410 variant via your hosted API.

Can you authorize a short-term promotional token buffer (we're estimating ~150k–250k tokens total) and a 48-hour extension on our trial window so we don't get throttled mid-test? If you need exact timings or an IP allowlist for the soak, Carlos and I can share the plan (attached).

Thanks — this POC is mission-critical for our roadmap. If we pass the soak we have a committed dedicated capacity conversation next quarter.

— Samantha
Head of ML, HelioPay

Attachment: heliopay_poc_test_plan.xlsx (xlsx)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@heliopay.com>
Cc: priyom_das, marissa_cole
Date: 2026-06-10T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Short-term token bump for POC warm-up

Samantha —

Thanks for the details and the test plan. We can usually provision a short-term promotional buffer for POCs like this; I just need a couple quick confirmations before routing to grants/finance:

- Exact expected start/end windows (timezone please)
- Target model and whether you’ll be using streaming or chunked generation
- Expected peak concurrency and whether you need a regional routing (we can pin to us-west)

I’m looping in Priyom (sales) and Marissa (finance/ops) so we can expedite. If you can send the exact 48-hour window and confirm the qps targets we can provision a temporary allowance and hold billing while the soak runs.

Also flagging that if you go over the buffer, we’ll either pause traffic or fall back to a lower-capacity variant — we’ll document the fallback policy in the portal.

Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Ben / Marissa —

I looked at the plan. Recommend we approve a provisional promotional grant of 200,000 tokens for HelioPay tied to the DEAL-HP-9421 opportunity, valid for a 48-hour window aligned to their soak. Conditions:

- Tokens will be consumed on the hosted API only (no private deployment drawdown).
- Automatic throttling/fallback to rdx-medium if their spike exceeds limits.
- Finance to put a temporary billing hold for consumption during the grant window; any overage after the window will be billed at standard rates unless we approve an extension.

Marissa — can you confirm billing hold and prepare the promo terms PDF? Ben, once Marissa signs off I’ll notify Samantha that we’ve provisioned the buffer.

— Priyom
Director, Sales Operations

All —

Confirmed: Finance has approved a one-time promotional token grant of 200,000 tokens tied to DEAL-HP-9421. I attached the promo_terms.pdf and an example usage_report_sample.csv for HelioPay to review.

Implementation notes for the customer:
- Grant window: 2026-06-12T18:00:00Z through 2026-06-14T18:00:00Z (48 hours).
- Tokens provisioned to HelioPay's hosted account and visible in the console under the temporary "promo:HP-9421" allocation.
- We will hold billing for that allocation during the window; any consumption beyond 200k will generate an overage alert and post-window invoice unless an extension is requested before the end time.
- Security: If you need an IP allowlist for the test traffic, please provide the CIDR ranges and we’ll add them to the account for the window.

Samantha — I’ve also added the HubSpot deal link and DocuSign route to finalize the terms (links below). Ben / Priyom, I’ve cc'd the legal templates team if we need a custom amendment.

Ben — please confirm when you see the allocation live and send Samantha the console link.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
